        """Test that DefaultLayoutPassManager does not construct layout passes when coupling_map is None."""
        # Create a pass manager config with None coupling map
        from qiskit.transpiler.passmanager_config import PassManagerConfig

            coupling_map=None,

            backend_options=None,
            seed_transpiler=42,

        # Create the pass manager plugin
        plugin = DefaultLayoutPassManager()
        
        # This should not raise an error and should not include layout passes
        pm = plugin.pass_manager(config, optimization_level=0)
        
        # Check that the pass manager doesn't contain layout passes when coupling_map is None
        # We'll check by examining what passes are in the pass manager
        passes = [type(pass_) for pass_ in pm.passes()]
        # Should not contain TrivialLayout, DenseLayout, or SabreLayout

class TestNoLayoutPassesWithNoneCouplingMap(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test that layout passes are not constructed when coupling_map is None."""

    def test_preset_pass_manager_works_with_none_coupling_map(self):
        """Test that preset pass managers work with coupling_map=None.
        
        This regression test ensures that PR #14353 is properly implemented:
        when coupling_map=None, layout passes should not be constructed, preventing
        runtime errors that would occur when these passes try to use None as a coupling_map.
        """
        # Test with a simple circuit
        q = QuantumRegister(2, name="q")
        circuit = QuantumCircuit(q)
        circuit.cx(q[0], q[1])
        
        # This should work without errors because layout passes are not constructed
        # when coupling_map is None (the fix from PR #14353)
        result = generate_preset_pass_manager(
            optimization_level=3,
            coupling_map=None,
            basis_gates=["u1", "u2", "u3", "cx"]

        # The result should be a valid circuit
        self.assertIsInstance(result, QuantumCircuit)

    def test_preset_pass_manager_works_with_coupling_map(self):
        """Test that preset pass managers still work with a coupling map."""

        q = QuantumRegister(2, name="q")
        circuit = QuantumCircuit(q)
        circuit.cx(q[0], q[1])
        
        # Test with a coupling map (should still work as before)
        from qiskit.transpiler import CouplingMap

        result = generate_preset_pass_manager(
            optimization_level=3,

            basis_gates=["u1", "u2", "u3", "cx"]
        ).run(circuit)
        
        # The result should be a valid circuit
        self.assertIsInstance(result, QuantumCircuit)

        """Test that demonstrates the behavior change from PR #14353.
        
        Before PR #14353: Layout passes were constructed with coupling_map=None
        and would fail when executed.
        
        After PR #14353: Layout passes are not constructed at all when

        circuit.cx(q[0], q[1])
        circuit.cx(q[1], q[2])
        
        # This should work correctly with the fix in place
        result = generate_preset_pass_manager(
            optimization_level=1,
            coupling_map=None,
            basis_gates=["u1", "u2", "u3", "cx"]
        ).run(circuit)
        
        self.assertIsInstance(result, QuantumCircuit)
